$comment: p15-oracle-079: the agentPane, agentChat, agent and chief action families (the ids of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json whose family prefix is agentPane, agentChat, agent or chief and that scripts/cmux-next/every-action-gaps.json neither excludes nor lists as a gap: 54 ids; the 6 agentPane gaps are p15-oracle-085's). scripts/cmux-next/oracle/gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071) reads this file (load_tuning) and writes one case per action into the flat actions suite. Each entry was reviewed against its handler in Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextApp (AgentHandlers, AgentChat*Handlers, AgentConfigurationHandlers, AgentSessionTab/Workspace, ChiefInspectorHandlers, ChiefUsagePage, ChiefViewsPageTab, AgentHarnessHandlers, ChiefSidebar). The bench launch runs the mock agent pane (CMUX_NEXT_AGENT_PANE_MOCK=1, ACPMUX_AGENT_LAUNCH=deny): a new chat never gets a session the app sees, so every action that needs a started chat runs its typed refusal here and names that success path as untested. A focused-chat action first waits for the chat context's dock to take the focus (chat-shown). receipt is the ActionEffect kind (legacy bind/run handlers report action.done), error the typed answer a script caller gets (a refusal is control.unavailable). A `note` that starts with `divergence <key>` files a finding for routing; the case stays green because the oracle is differential.
